card_json.headline: BSE to cut quarterly core SGF contribution to 3.5% of profit from 5% after crossing ₹150 Cr threshold
card_json.takeaway: FY26 was a record year on derivatives and co-location, and management is trimming its voluntary SGF charge, but it gave no volume or market-share guidance for FY27.
card_json.core_catalyst: Record derivatives premium turnover and co-location revenue lifting FY26 revenue 59% to ₹5,148 Cr

what_happened.text: **SGF contribution cut:** quarterly voluntary contribution to core SGF reduced to **3.5% of profits** from 5% after crossing the ₹150 Cr threshold.
what_happened.quote: At this point of time when we review, we have already touched the threshold of more than 150 crores. We have crossed it, and in that situation, we are reducing the contribution requirement per quarter from 5% to 3.5%.

what_happened.text: **Other expenses:** ICCL took an **ECL provision** on an old **₹80 Cr** outstanding from NSE, which raised the quarter's other expenses.
what_happened.quote: There is an outstanding of Rs. 80 crore, which is an old outstanding from NSE. So, we have taken some ECL provision that is in line with our ECL policy and accounting standard requirement, which has led to this increase in the current quarter.

what_happened.text: **Derivatives launch:** derivatives on the **BSE Focused IT Index** to be launched from **11 May 2026**; two more monthly index derivatives approved.
what_happened.quote: Based on market feedback, derivatives on the BSE Focused IT Index will be launched from 11 May 2026, further expanding and strengthening our monthly derivatives suite.

what_happened.text: **Dividend:** board recommended **₹10 per share** for FY26, total payout **₹412 Cr**, up 30% overall and 67% excluding last year's special dividend.
what_happened.quote: The total payout for the year would be Rs. 412 crores, which is an increase of 30% from last year on an overall basis, and 67% excluding the special dividend that was announced on account of 150 years of BSE last year.

why_it_matters.text: The SGF cut lowers a recurring charge on profit, but management declined to give any forward SGF number, saying the computation rests on a complex set of parameters.
why_it_matters.quote: Other than that, a forward-looking number cannot be put. As I said, the SGF computation is based on a complex set of parameters.

why_it_matters.text: FY26 revenue of ₹5,148 Cr is 59% above FY25's ₹3,236 Cr, and the filing calls it the best year in BSE's 150-year history.
why_it_matters.quote: reached Rs. 5,148 crores, as compared to Rs. 3,236 crores in FY25, translating into a year-on-year growth of 59%.

why_it_matters.text: Management set no volume or market-share target for FY27, saying it will not give forward-looking numbers; it tracks member, FPI and co-location counts instead.
why_it_matters.quote: And if I were to put a forward-looking number, sorry, I will not be able to put any forward-looking number in terms of volumes or market share because that is not where we are strategizing and putting our targets.

card_json.headline: Vodafone Idea call: AGR dues cut to ₹64,046 Cr, ₹55,622 Cr one-time gain; 3x EBITDA targeted
card_json.takeaway: The AGR overhang is settled at a lower figure and the promoter is putting in equity, but the 3x EBITDA and double-digit revenue targets still depend on a bank facility that is not yet closed.
card_json.core_catalyst: AGR liability reassessed lower, freeing cash flows while a ₹45,000 Cr three-year capex plan and SBI-led ₹25,000 Cr facility fund the network build

what_happened.text: DoT committee finalised AGR dues at **₹64,046 Cr** as of 31 Dec 2025, down from the frozen **₹87,695 Cr**; balance payable in six ₹10,608 Cr instalments from March 2036.
what_happened.quote: Our AGR dues have been finalised at Rs 64,046 Crore as of December 31, 2025 — a reduction from the earlier frozen figure of Rs 87,695 Crore.

what_happened.text: The ₹80,502 Cr liability was derecognised and ₹24,880 Cr recognised; the **₹55,622 Cr** difference went to the P&L as an exceptional item, producing FY26 net profit of **₹34,552 Cr**.
what_happened.quote: The resulting difference of Rs. 55,622 Crores, along with net impact of other related provisions, has been credited to the P&L as an exceptional item in the quarter and the full year financials ended March 31, 2026.

what_happened.text: **Capex plan:** ₹45,000 Cr over three years, funded by a ₹25,000 Cr funded and ₹10,000 Cr non-funded SBI-led consortium facility.
what_happened.quote: We are looking at a funded facility of Rs. 25,000 Crores and a non-funded facility of Rs. 10,000 Crores.

what_happened.text: **Cash EBITDA margin:** at 20% now, management targets "north of 35%" over three to four years without naming the year.
what_happened.quote: If you use the numbers we’ve shared before they translate to a double-digit revenue growth and the cash EBITDA number will be north of 35%.

why_it_matters.text: The AGR cut removes ₹23,649 Cr of liability and pushes most repayment past FY35, but the ₹10,608 Cr annual instalments from March 2036 still sit against a negative net worth of ₹35,758 Cr.
why_it_matters.quote: The balance AGR dues have to be paid in 6 equal annual installments of Rs. 10,608 Crore from March’36 to March’41.

why_it_matters.text: The FY26 profit of ₹34,552 Cr is almost entirely the ₹55,622 Cr exceptional credit; Q4 EBITDA of ₹4,889 Cr and the 43.1% margin are the operating numbers to judge the business on.
why_it_matters.quote: With this one-time benefit in exceptional items, we recorded a net profit of Rs. 51,970 Crores in Q4 FY 2026 and a net profit of Rs. 34,552 Crores for the full year of FY 2026.

why_it_matters.text: The 3x EBITDA and double-digit revenue targets rest on a bank facility management declined to date; the ₹4,730 Cr promoter warrant issue is the only committed equity in the plan.
why_it_matters.quote: We are deeply engaged, as we have said, it's an SBI-led consortium which is looking into this, the consortium is composed of PSU banks, private banks as well as the foreign banks.

missing_disclosures: No timeline for closing the ₹25,000 Cr SBI-led facility
No year named for the "north of 35%" cash EBITDA margin target
No circle-wise subscriber or revenue data despite analyst requests
